texts.text:
Be sure the Robot Odyssey I
disk is in the drive.

Then:

Use the Innovation Lab to design
and test circuits in robots and
the large prototype chip.

Burn a small chip from your pro-
totype chip in the Burn Room.

Change maze walls with the paint-
brush. Change sensor bodies and
maze objects in the Shape Editor.

For help, see Tutorials and
Manual.

Press ESC to go to menu.
Press S to save Lab.

Please be sure the Robot Odyssey I
disk is in the disk drive.

RETURN     Move to next line. From
           last line, move to top.
To go back to Record room, press RETURN.
To go back to the Lab, press RETURN.
